purpose: Where each competition raster used by the live-anchored emission calibration is mirrored publicly, so scripts/restore_artifacts.py can fetch and content-hash it. This file records LOCATIONS ONLY. It deliberately contains no SHA-256 values and no scores: hashes are computed from the fetched bytes and scores are matched by hash from evidence/provenance/gemsdoe27_live_scores_snapshot.json (or pinned in registry/data_manifest.json). Nothing here is asserted that was not read from a directory listing.
how_paths_were_verified: For every repository listed below, the full git tree was listed through the GitHub REST API (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/trees/HEAD?recursive=1) from this sandbox on 2026-10-02 and the .tif paths were copied from that listing. api.github.com is reachable from the sandbox; drivendata.org was not contacted.
provenance_warning: Rasters are owner mirrors of the group's own submissions. A matching SHA-256 proves the mirror is unchanged and lets a file be tied to a row of the owner's score ledger; it does NOT prove the bytes are the file the organizer scored, and the scores themselves are user/owner-reported public-leaderboard values, not receipts.

score_snapshot.status: secondary quote of owner-reported public-leaderboard values; the sibling repository states the same warning

already_pinned_locally.note: These are restored by scripts/restore_data.py --group scored with SHA-256 pins in registry/data_manifest.json; restore_artifacts.py reuses the local copy instead of downloading it again.
